units.en: First, if the ⟦0⟧ defeats the ⟦1⟧ in war through the national focus ⟦2⟧ and all American cores are owned and controlled by the UK, a decision called "Create Pan-North-American State" will appear and once chosen, all North American territories owned by the UK will be given to ⟦3⟧, which will have its name changed to the ⟦4⟧, and gain cores on all US cores, including Alaska along with a new flag. After that is done, once the Imperial Federation is formed, the UK will also gain cores on all US core territory, greatly increasing both population, resource, and industrial capacity and expanding the Imperial Federation to an even greater size. For best results, one should complete the national focus ⟦5⟧ and carry out all decisions in it first, then annex the United States and give all of their territories to Canada, and then finally complete the national focus ⟦6⟧ after all that.

Second, if the ⟦0⟧ is Fascist, then after the Imperial Federation is formed with the United States included, this opens up the curious fact of the United Kingdom being the only country that is allowed to form the ⟦1⟧ while fascist, allowing the Imperial Federation to be expanded to its greatest possible size. The Imperial Federation simply needs to conquer and annex the starting core states of the EU:s constituent countries (France, Germany, Italy, and the Low countries) to unlock the decision to integrate them. If then formed, this ⟦2⟧ (comprising the British Empire, the United States, and the European Union territories) will have a combined core population of nearly half a ⟦3⟧ people (or nearly 500 million people, around the same level as the core population of ⟦4⟧ or ⟦5⟧!).

Finally, if your dominions form nations and get new core states, you can get cores on them as the Imperial Federation. There are two dominions capable of doing so: ⟦0⟧ can form ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ can form ⟦3⟧. (Note that the Imperial Federation can not get core on ⟦4⟧ or ⟦5⟧.) However, ⟦6⟧ needs independence or dominion autonomy level, and ⟦7⟧ needs to be fully independent for them to form these nations, making this process difficult in singleplayer without console commands. Also, Polynesia requires Hawaii to be formed, meaning that it will be very tricky to create both the pan-American state (needed for cores in the USA) and Polynesia.

Through cores being transferred from formable to formable, it's possible to core even more land. ⟦0⟧ can be included in the Imperial "Super" Federation through two formable nations, the ⟦1⟧, and the ⟦2⟧. The ⟦3⟧ can be formed by Bourbon ⟦4⟧ with the focus ⟦5⟧. The ⟦6⟧ can also be formed by ⟦7⟧ if they capitulate to the ⟦8⟧ whilst allied to the ⟦9⟧. While forming the ⟦10⟧ may seem redundant, as cores are gained on metropolitan ⟦11⟧ through the founding of the ⟦12⟧, but not all French cores are cored from forming the ⟦13⟧, but the ⟦14⟧ does transfer all French cores to the ⟦15⟧. This allows not just the coring of ⟦16⟧ through the ⟦17⟧, but also most of ⟦18⟧’s colonies through the French focus ⟦19⟧ and Pyrénées-Atlantique because Paradox forgot to update the decision to form the ⟦20⟧ when they added this state. ⟦21⟧ can unite with another nation and their cores will also get transferred over, that is ⟦22⟧. ⟦23⟧ can unite with ⟦24⟧ to form ⟦25⟧ with the focus ⟦26⟧. ⟦27⟧ inclusion also adds core on ⟦28⟧ through the focus ⟦29⟧ ( ⟦30⟧ is already covered by ⟦31⟧) and yet another formable nation, the ⟦32⟧, with it being formable by the Portuguese focus ⟦33⟧, thus coring all of ⟦34⟧. With ⟦35⟧, non-⟦36⟧ ⟦37⟧ can further core all of South America.
The ⟦0⟧ will thus have been founded, ensuring that the British Empire shall indeed endure the test of time and last a thousand years Winston Churchill once said. ⟦1⟧

⟦0⟧ ENG will not receive cores from the British Raj or British Malaya to illustrate cultural differences (also done to counteract the OPness of gaining full access to all Indian manpower, which even British Raj/India doesn’t get).

⟦0⟧ When playing as monarchist UK with non-historical AI, there is a chance that the UK will not receive cores on South Africa even after a successful Imperial Conference. As of patch 1.10.3, the UK being granted South African cores requires that South Africa has completed the ⟦1⟧ national focus. If South Africa's ⟦2⟧ focus isn't completed before the Dominions break with the Crown in 1936, the ⟦3⟧ focus will be blocked, making it impossible for the UK to receive South African cores via the Imperial Federation. (If historical AI is enabled, select Support the Policy of Appeasement and Police Windhoek before the Dominions break away, avoiding this issue.)
The ⟦0⟧ is a monarchic union between ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ that can be formed by ⟦3⟧ if they go monarchist under the Legitimists and completes the national focus ⟦4⟧.

Note that if Spain managed to form the ⟦0⟧ with ⟦1⟧ after the latter formed the ⟦2⟧, France will also gain cores on all Portuguese and Brazilian States as well, creating an empire comparable to the ⟦3⟧ or the ⟦4⟧ in terms of population, industry and potential military power.

A technical explanation of how the ⟦0⟧ focus works: It gives ⟦1⟧ cores for each ⟦2⟧ core state. ⟦3⟧ only appears when ⟦4⟧ completes the focus ⟦5⟧ which causes the ⟦6⟧ to break away. If ⟦7⟧ completed the focus ⟦8⟧, its cosmetic will change to ⟦9⟧, but its tag will ⟦10⟧ be ⟦11⟧ (its tag will remain ⟦12⟧ or ⟦13⟧), so ⟦14⟧ can't inherit all cores of it (in this case, ⟦15⟧ can only get cores of the original Spanish states even if ⟦16⟧ formed ⟦17⟧).

The ⟦0⟧ is a formable nation that can be created by ⟦1⟧ as part of the monarchist branch of the national focus tree and is effectively an alternative version of the ⟦2⟧, albeit exclusive to Lithuania.

Historically, it is a continuation of the many different polities that once existed in the area under the name of Livonia, tracing their lineage all the way back to the Livonian tribe of the Early Middle Ages before the area was Christianised. More specifically, the Kingdom of Livonia is most likely a restoration of either the Duchy of Livonia (which existed from 1561 to 1621) or the original Kingdom of Livonia (which existed from 1570 to 1578) or it could be interpreted as being connected to the long succession of Livonian governorates that existed from the 1620s to 1918 under Swedish, Polish and later Russian rule.

After crowning Karl Gero von Urach as King of Lithuania under the regnal name of Mindaugas III, Lithuania can then proceed to claim the lands of Livonia (comprising ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧) through the national focus tree ⟦2⟧. This will cause Lithuania to become the ⟦3⟧, changing both its flag and map colour in addition to gaining cores on all of the territories of Estonia and Latvia, along with a conquest war goal in said nations for good measure. A follow-up focus named ⟦4⟧ allows Livonia to also claim the throne of ⟦5⟧ and facilitate a reunification of the two countries (citing the ⟦6⟧). If Poland refuses the offer but monarchist support in the country is high enough, a civil war will ignite between the government and the royalists, the latter of which will have Poland join Livonia if they win (Poland will become a puppet of the ⟦7⟧ and switch their map colour to match Livonia).
The ⟦0⟧ is another monarchic union that can be established, in this case between ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧.

Historically, the Kingdom of Poland existed in various iterations from as early as 1025 AD until its demise in 1795. The kingdom was restored in a way as the semi-autonomous polity of Congress Poland, existing from 1815 to 1867, with an attempted real restoration during the November Uprisings of 1830-1831 and the January Uprising of 1864. After this, Poland's autonomy was severely curtailed and the Kingdom of Poland thereafter was mostly a formality, existing only on paper. After the collapse of the Russian Empire in 1917, the Kingdom of Poland was re-established by the German Empire and a Regency Council was inaugurated with the task of electing a king to the vacant throne. This ultimately never came to pass, as Germany was defeated by the Entente and signed an armistice on the 11th November 1918. The Regency Council of the newly formed Kingdom of Poland failed to crown a King before Marshal Józef Piłsudski declared the ⟦0⟧, which still exists in 1936.

However, Polish monarchism may not be completely dead yet, and Poland can opt to fulfill the 5th of November Act, a promise made by the Central Powers to release a Kingdom of Poland from the occupied territories of the Russian Empire. Once the Regency Council has been assembled anew, three claimants to the throne may be chosen from; The Hohenzollern (Michael II of Romania), The Commonwealth Claimant (Friedrich Christian of the House of Wettin), and the Cossack-King (Pavel Bermondt-Avalov, a warlord, a cossack, and a Georgian Prince).

Out of these options, the Commonwealth Claimant (Friedrich Chrstian of Wettin) will allow Poland to seek a restoration of the ⟦0⟧, while the Hohenzollern (Michael II of Romania) will open up the path towards forming the ⟦1⟧. Poland and Romania enjoyed close relations in the timeframe leading up to World War II, and with the throne of Poland vacant, Poland can elevate these relations to new heights by electing a Romanian king. From here, the two nations can be united into one kingdom under the right circumstances; either by Polish pressure or if Romania completes the national focus ⟦2⟧. With Poland and Romania united into one kingdom, Poland-Romania may either align itself with the Allies or appoint a royal dictatorship and seek to expand further by conquering ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ by restoring the union of Poland-Hungary. Once fully realised, the ⟦5⟧ will form a powerful wall between the Axis and Comintern, taking a similar role as the late ⟦6⟧ and ⟦7⟧ as a monarchic union state that acts as the guardian of stability in the region.

The ⟦0⟧ is the recreation of Alexander the Great's Empire spanning from Greece to India which formed during his reign of 336-323 BC and fell apart almost immediately after Alexander's death. As ⟦1⟧ it may be formed with the ⟦2⟧ leader George Mercouris and the ⟦3⟧ Focus or with the ⟦4⟧ leader ⟦5⟧ and the ⟦6⟧ focus.

Should the ⟦0⟧ be dismantled for whatever reason, then one of the releasable successor states in the North Caucasus can decide to pick up the pieces of the fallen union and save what still can be saved by forming a united ⟦1⟧ to prevent the lands north of the Caucasus from falling under foreign influence. The nation takes its name from the briefly-existing Mountainous Republic of the Northern Caucasus. In order to form North Caucasia, most of the area between the Don River and Caucassus in the ⟦2⟧ must be controlled.
Mountainous People's Republic of the Northern Caucasus
The ⟦0⟧ is an extended version of ⟦1⟧, representing a greater union of all the Nordic nations, including also ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧. If chosen, the ⟦4⟧ and the ⟦5⟧ cannot be formed.

The forming nation must be one of the Nordic countries ( ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, or ⟦4⟧), and requires all aforementioned nations to be united under one banner. Additionally, should Estonia complete the focus ⟦5⟧, the decision will be available to Estonia as well, although it does not require any additional cores.
This nation can be formed by ⟦0⟧ via the Swedish focus ⟦1⟧ after concentrating on the old enemy and then forming the said Nordic Defense Council.

This nation is formable through the communist focus branch of ⟦0⟧. In history, Leon Trostsky spent over a year in exile in Norway until his deportation to Mexico in December in 1936. Instead of deporting Trotsky as happened historically, or following the ⟦1⟧ ideology of communism, the Northern Revolutionary Front represents a nation that has fully embraced Trotskys ideals and establishes a new communist international.

To form the Northern Revolutionary Front the player needs to go down the communist path ⟦0⟧ and give Trotsky a seat in government. The player gets to do this through an event within the first year of the game. However if the Soviet Union goes down the left opposition alternate history focus path involving Trotsky, this event does not fire for Norway. When Trotsky has been given a place in the government, the focus ⟦1⟧ will form the Northern Revolutionary Front and change the color, name and flag of the nation.

The ⟦0⟧ is a formable nation that includes ⟦1⟧, mainland ⟦2⟧, parts of ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧. It can be formed by ⟦5⟧ or ⟦6⟧ and is the natural successor of the North Sea Empire, which for most of the period between 1013 and 1042 towards the end of the Viking Age was led by Cnut the Great. The easiest way to form the ⟦7⟧ is as ⟦8⟧ by unifying the Right. Now you can either decide to follow the monarchist or the fascist path and in the end gain an Annex war goal against the ⟦9⟧ via the focus ⟦10⟧. If chosen, the ⟦11⟧ and the ⟦12⟧ cannot be formed.
Upon formation, the country color changes to a dark purple.
Not to be confused with Reichskommissariat Ostland, a puppet state formable by ⟦0⟧.

Available as part of ⟦0⟧'s fascist path, ⟦1⟧ is an oddball case when it comes to formable nations, as it is an artifical state invented by Germany and can be established by Latvia for personal benefit and profit.
